scene_target: The party accepts a quest and engages scavengers to test their synergy.
goal: Execute a coordinated attack using system exploits to bypass taxes.
conflict: Artie must draw aggro while at critically low HP (4/100) without dying before Rhea can trigger the environmental hazard.
end_condition: Artie successfully draws the scavengers' aggro, and Rhea is in position to trigger the environmental trap.
transition_in_text: After forming the party, Vex pulls a low-level quest from the terminal, and the trio heads to a collapsed transit tunnel to test their exploit.
transition_out_text: Artie holds the scavengers' attention by a thread as Rhea prepares to drop the ceiling on them.

inventory_alignment_updates.reason: Rhea stowed the credits to free her left hand.

last_scene: After forming the party, Vex pulled a low-level quest from the terminal, and the trio headed to a collapsed transit tunnel.
Artie used a jagged piece of rebar to draw the scavengers' aggro despite being at critically low HP.
Rhea positioned herself to trigger an environmental hazard, preparing to drop the ceiling on the distracted mobs.
key_events: The party accepted the Vermin Control quest.
Rhea stowed her Copper Credits to prepare for combat.
Artie successfully drew aggro from the scavengers in the collapsed transit tunnel.
Rhea moved into position to execute the physics exploit with her Makeshift Masonry Bludgeon.
chapter_so_far_add: The newly formed party accepted a low-level extermination quest to test their exploit.
Artie drew the aggro of the scavengers in the collapsed transit tunnel, risking his last 4 HP.
Rhea prepared to drop the tunnel ceiling on the scavengers to secure untaxed kills.
